svg.title: Incremental materialized views turn inserted sales blocks into reusable aggregate states
svg.desc: Two insert blocks contain four distinct sales lines, each for one unit at SGD 8, with transaction IDs A and B in the first block and A and C in the second. An incremental materialized view computes State aggregates for each new block into an AggregatingMergeTree target. Raw queries regroup the four lines; aggregate queries Merge the stored states. Both return four units, SGD 32, and three distinct transactions. Existing history requires a separate one-time backfill; queries need not wait for background merges.

text.tspan: Compute each inserted block once; reuse its aggregate states in later queries.
Example: the district, SKU, minute, run, source, and branch are the same for all four lines.
Insert A: transaction IDs A, B
Insert B: transaction IDs A, C
Read and group transaction lines again
Combine stored states at query time
The target uses AggregatingMergeTree. Query with -Merge; do not wait for background merges.
District/SKU/minute supports chain analysis. Add store_id for the store-level pricing aggregate.
